This bundle contains the official Three.js 0.149.0 GLTFLoader, BufferGeometryUtils dependencies and SkeletonUtils.clone from the npm `three` package. It exports `window.MamuliGLTFLoader` and `window.MamuliSkeletonClone` and imports the existing `window.THREE`; it does not include a second Three runtime.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.149.0.tgz

License: MIT, see `three.LICENSE`.

The app uses it for PBR scene hierarchy, animations, skinning, sparse morph accessors and KHR_mesh_quantization. Existing static assets retain the small legacy GLB reader.
